mailboxes.title: Email tracking (optional)

mailbox_provider.title: Add a mailbox
mailbox_provider.description: Pick your provider to prefill server, port and encryption, or "Other" to enter everything yourself.

mailbox_connection.title: IMAP connection
mailbox_connection.description:
The connection is tested when you submit.

Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud: use an **app password** (the account password is rejected). Microsoft Outlook/Hotmail only accepts OAuth2 on most accounts.

data_description.name: Shown in the mailbox list. Defaults to the username.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the standard port: 993 for SSL/TLS, 143 for STARTTLS or no encryption.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only disable for a local server with a self-signed certificate (Proton Mail Bridge, home server…).
data_description.password: When editing, leave empty to keep the current password.

data.mark_seen: Mark emails containing a tracking number as read

data_description.folders: You can also type a folder name.
data_description.dedicated: Parse every email, not only those from known carriers. Ideal for an address that only receives shipping notifications.
data_description.enabled: Uncheck to pause scanning without deleting the mailbox.

webhook.title: Real-time notifications (webhook)
webhook.description:
17track can notify Home Assistant as soon as a package changes, instead of waiting for the next 30-minute cycle.

1. Enable the option below.
2. Copy this URL: `{webhook_url}`
3. Paste it in the 17track dashboard ({dashboard_url}), WebHook section, then save and test.

Home Assistant must be reachable from the Internet (Nabu Casa or a configured external URL). Calls are verified with the 17track signature.
